exit_criteria.statement: Zero parallel authorities: every located engineering authority is crosswalked and none is claimed by this programme.
Zero duplicate constitutional capabilities: nothing is dispositioned CREATE, and every capability resolves to a located owner.
Zero duplicate knowledge: every governed entity holds exactly one Canonical Knowledge Object, and Knowledge Once is preserved because extracted knowledge is registered in its located home.
Zero duplicate lifecycles: the constitutional lifecycle is CONSUMED from a single located owner and no stage is originated here.
Zero duplicate engineering engines: no capability is invoked and no owner is re-run, so no second execution surface exists.
Zero duplicate governance models: checks, gates, programmes and principles are read from their single located owner.
Zero hidden execution paths: the write set is exactly the declared register set, and residue is impossible because nothing is invoked.
Zero privileged engineering paths: this engine appears in the goal plane as a subject, and no executable literal names its own home.
Zero determinism violations: every derived plan is byte-stable across two derivations at one repository state.
Zero replay violations: the registers are a pure function of the declaration, the discovered manifests and the consumed lifecycle.
Zero governance ambiguity: every authority resolves, carries its cited anchor, and is marked unmergeable.
Zero unresolved mandatory dependencies: no relation dangles and every adapter resolves.
Zero orphan canonical capabilities: every declared capability names a located owner.
Zero undiscovered canonical owners: every completion invariant resolves to a located owner carrying its cited anchor.
Every engineering activity is resolved through REUSE, then EXTEND, then CREATE, and CREATE is reachable only where Repository Truth locates no owner.
Given only a goal, Repository Truth and the constitutional framework, the substrate derives a complete, bound, deterministic engineering plan with no manual engineering decision.
Every engineering cycle reduces future engineering: no plan step requires engineering infrastructure that does not already exist, so the marginal infrastructure cost of a further goal is zero.

No new architectural principle is introduced: the object model, provider and adapter architecture, identity model, applicability model, graph composition and fail-closed guard pattern are all Ω-E04's, reused unchanged.
No implementation depends on hardcoded lifecycle, owner or capability knowledge: the zero-enumeration guard proves no discovered value appears as an executable literal.
The lifecycle is non-terminal: goals and stages both re-enter, so engineering does not end (CR-INF-001).

Constitutional coverage balances: every capability of the consumed lifecycle is owned, authorized, traversed and dispositioned from Repository Truth, with zero missing, zero unowned, zero undispositioned and zero requiring creation.

findings.detail: The aggregate certifier discloses that ratifying authority is vacant (UCCEP-F-004), and Ω-E04 inherited that cap. This programme inherits it too: it records a measurement and confers no ratification and no finality.

findings.why_not_repaired: A vacancy of ratifying authority cannot be closed by any act inside this repository. Asserting finality here would manufacture an authority the constitution does not grant, which is a graver defect than the disclosure.

findings.detail: This programme derives a plan and measures its binding; it invokes no capability. The declared pipeline executes the located owners, and the repository-directed loop drives them to convergence. Both are named in the plan contract.

findings.why_not_repaired: Invoking the capabilities this programme measures would make it observe a run of itself, which is the self-observation topology RFP-3 forbids and which would stop the repository converging. It would also duplicate an execution surface the repository already owns.

findings.detail: Plans traverse exactly the stages the located owner declares. If a constitutional act is missing from that owner, no plan derived here will contain it, and this programme reports the absence rather than inventing the stage.

findings.why_not_repaired: Adding a stage here would create a second lifecycle, which CMG-000001 Art LXXVI.6 forbids. A missing stage is admitted by appending a node to the located owner's manifest, which that owner's own admission clause provides for.

programme.$forbidden_write_comment: Every owner this programme cites must be protected from its own writes. The declaration guard fails closed if a cited claimant is not covered here, so a new citation cannot be introduced without also protecting its owner.
programme.authority: NONE — DERIVED TRUTH. This programme legislates no lifecycle, opens no registry, mints no identifier, declares no namespace, admits no capability, authorizes no engineering and certifies nothing. UCIC-001 owns the single deterministic lifecycle every capability follows; UCL-000001 made that lifecycle discoverable, ordered and executable, and this programme CONSUMES its stage graph rather than deriving one — a second derivation would be a second lifecycle. UCOS-AEE-001 owns the closed repository-directed loop, which this programme neither duplicates nor re-drives: it invokes no engine and re-runs no owner. UCOS-EG-001 owns engineering governance; UCCEP-000000 owns certification; UCOS-RFP-001 owns fixed-point closure; UEI-000001 and UCEF-000001 own evolution; UER-000001 owns recovery; URRC-000001 owns reuse measurement. This programme BINDS an engineering goal to those located owners and measures whether the binding is total. Where this measurement and a located instrument differ, the located instrument governs.
programme.disclosure: DISCLOSURE. This programme holds no constitutional authority. It is not a second lifecycle, not a second loop, not a second registry, not a second dictionary, not a second identifier scheme, not a second reasoning engine, not a second learning engine, not a second discovery engine, not a second execution engine and not a competing methodology. It creates no goal, no invariant and no stage: every goal and every completion invariant is discovered from a located manifest pattern, and every lifecycle stage is consumed from its located owner. It enumerates nothing. It invokes no capability, so it never observes a run of itself. It holds no privileged path: it appears in its own goal plane as a subject like any other.
